entries.en: Wheiskaet would first like to verify that you are not a complete fraud.
entries.fr: Wheiskaet voudrait vous soumettre à un test pour évaluer vos compétences.
entries.ja: コスタ・デル・ソルのヴェイスケートは、本番の前の肩慣らしをさせたいようだ。
entries.de: Wheiskaet möchte sich zunächst von deinen Fä<->hig<->kei<->ten überzeugen.
entries.section: Main Scenario (A Realm Reborn through Endwalker)
entries.category: Seventh Umbral Era Main Scenario Quests

entries.en: Before he bothers giving you a truly demanding task, Wheiskaet would first have you attend to a simple one. Place the herring he has given you on an eastern cape near Costa del Sol to lure out the nix that has been seen in the vicinity.
entries.fr: Wheiskaet vous a ordonné d'abattre <frnoun(BNpcName,1,1976,1,1)>. Il vous a donné <frnoun(EventItem,1,2000636,1,1)> qu'il vous a demandé de déposer à l'endroit qu'il a indiqué sur votre carte.
entries.ja: ゲゲルジュからの依頼に取りかかる前に、<sheet(BNpcName,1976,0)>を倒すよう指示された。「<sheet(EObj,2002035,0)>」に 「<sheet(EventItem,2000636,0)>」を仕掛けよう。
entries.de: Erlege <denoun(BNpcName,2,1976,1,4,1)>, bevor du einen Auftrag von Meister Gegeruju erhältst. Lege dazu am <denoun(EObj,5,2002035,1,3,1)> <denoun(EventItem,2,2000636,1,4,1)> als Köder aus.
entries.section: Main Scenario (A Realm Reborn through Endwalker)
entries.category: Seventh Umbral Era Main Scenario Quests

entries.en: Having baited the trap with your herring, all that remains is to wait for and slay the nix that comes forth to claim it.
entries.fr: Vous avez déposé <frnoun(EventItem,2,2000636,1,1)> comme convenu. Patientez à l'endroit indiqué et abattez <frnoun(BNpcName,2,1976,1,1)> pour obtenir <frnoun(EventItem,1,2000637,1,1)>.
entries.ja: <sheet(EObj,2002639,0)>で待機し、「<sheet(BNpcName,1976,0)>」を倒して「<sheet(EventItem,2000637,0)>」を入手しよう。
entries.de: Warte am <denoun(EObj,5,2002639,1,3,1)>, erlege <denoun(BNpcName,2,1976,1,4,1)> und besorge dir so <denoun(EventItem,1,2000637,1,4,1)>.
entries.section: Main Scenario (A Realm Reborn through Endwalker)
entries.category: Seventh Umbral Era Main Scenario Quests

entries.en: You dispatch the slimy creature with great fanfare and sever one of its legs as proof of your kill. Show Wheiskaet that the deed is done.
entries.fr: Vous avez abattu <frnoun(BNpcName,2,1976,1,1)> et récupéré une cuisse bien charnue. Portez-la à Wheiskaet pour lui prouver que vous avez accompli votre mission avec succès.
entries.ja: <sheet(BNpcName,1976,0)>を倒し、<sheet(EventItem,2000637,0)>を手に入れた。コスタ・デル・ソルの「ヴェイスケート」に渡そう。
entries.de: Du hast <denoun(EventItem,1,2000637,1,4,1)> erhalten. Bringe es zu Wheiskaet an der Sonnenküste.
entries.section: Main Scenario (A Realm Reborn through Endwalker)
entries.category: Seventh Umbral Era Main Scenario Quests

entries.en: Wheiskaet explains that a recent incident with a former employee has forced him to treat strangers with greater caution. Having proven yourself to be nothing like that other poor, unfortunate soul, he is now willing to give you a challenge as befits your talents.
entries.fr: Wheiskaet pense que vous êtes à la hauteur pour accomplir la mission qu'il vous réserve. Parlez-lui de nouveau pour en savoir plus.
entries.ja: ヴェイスケートは、冒険者の力が偽物ではないとわかってくれた。さぁ、ゲゲルジュの依頼を開始しよう。
entries.de: Wheiskaet ist von deinen Fä<->hig<->kei<->ten überzeugt. Jetzt könnt ihr endlich zur eigentlichen Aufgabe übergehen.
entries.section: Main Scenario (A Realm Reborn through Endwalker)
entries.category: Seventh Umbral Era Main Scenario Quests

entries.en: Use the herring to lure out the nix.
entries.section: Main Scenario (A Realm Reborn through Endwalker)
entries.category: Seventh Umbral Era Main Scenario Quests

entries.en: Lie in wait for the nix.
entries.fr: Attendre à l'endroit indiqué et abattre <frnoun(BNpcName,2,1976,1,1)>
entries.section: Main Scenario (A Realm Reborn through Endwalker)
entries.category: Seventh Umbral Era Main Scenario Quests

entries.en: Deliver the nix leg to Wheiskaet.
entries.ja: ヴェイスケートに<sheet(EventItem,2000637,0)>を渡す
entries.section: Main Scenario (A Realm Reborn through Endwalker)
entries.category: Seventh Umbral Era Main Scenario Quests

entries.en: Master Gegeruju's requests can be more demanding than you realize. Before I set you to your true task, I would like to verify that this won't be a waste of my time.
entries.fr: On va commencer par une tâche très simple pour évaluer tes compétences.
entries.ja:
ゲゲルジュの旦那からの依頼は、簡単なもんじゃない。
本番の前に、肩慣らしと行こうじゃないか。
entries.de: Die Aufträge des Meisters Gegeruju sind von hoher Gefährlichkeit. Um den Meister vor einer Enttäuschung im Falle des Nichtgelingens zu schützen, muss ich zuerst deine Tauglichkeit prüfen.
entries.speaker: WHEISKAET
entries.section: Main Scenario (A Realm Reborn through Endwalker)
entries.category: Seventh Umbral Era Main Scenario Quests

entries.en: A nix has recently been seen prowling the beach to the east. As you can imagine, my master does not want large slimy creatures anywhere near his lands.
entries.fr: Il y a <frnoun(BNpcName,1,1976,1,1)> affamé qui dévore tous les poissons qui ont le malheur de s'approcher trop près, surtout les plus gros, ce qui a le don d'agacer le seigneur Gegeruju.
entries.ja:
最近、西から流れてきたが、
海辺の魚を食い荒らして、旦那が気になさっている。
entries.de: In letzter Zeit leiden die Küstenregionen an einer <denoun(BNpcName,5,1976,2,1,1)>-Plage. Die Schädlinge sind aus den westlichen Gefilden eingewandert und fressen Fischlaich, was unsere Fischzucht gefährdet.
entries.speaker: WHEISKAET
entries.section: Main Scenario (A Realm Reborn through Endwalker)
entries.category: Seventh Umbral Era Main Scenario Quests

entries.en: The beast is cunning, but you should have no difficulty luring it out with herring.
entries.fr: Je vais donc te demander d'utiliser <frnoun(EventItem,6,2000636,1,1)> pour attirer la créature à toi et l'abattre.
entries.ja:
このを海岸に仕掛け、
食らいついたを倒してこい。
entries.de: Sie lassen sich aber gut jagen, indem man sie mit <denoun(EventItem,5,2000636,2,3,1)> anlockt. Man muss sie nur in Küstennähe auslegen.
entries.speaker: WHEISKAET
entries.section: Main Scenario (A Realm Reborn through Endwalker)
entries.category: Seventh Umbral Era Main Scenario Quests

entries.en: Slay the nix and return to me. Oh, and don't forget to bring me a leg as proof of the kill.
entries.fr: Et comme je ne sais pas encore si tu es un<if(gnum4,e,)> <if(gnum4,fe,ho)>mme de confiance, je vais te demander de me rapporter une de ses cuisses pour me prouver que tu as bien fait ton travail. Va<nbsp>!
entries.ja:
そうだな……お前が倒した証拠に、
でも、持ってきてもらおうか。
entries.de: Bringe mir <denoun(EventItem,2,2000637,1,4,1)> als Beweis, dass du auch wirklich welche erlegt hast. Viel Erfolg!
entries.speaker: WHEISKAET
entries.section: Main Scenario (A Realm Reborn through Endwalker)
entries.category: Seventh Umbral Era Main Scenario Quests

entries.en: Well? Did you deal with the nix?
entries.fr: Alors, tu m'as apporté <frnoun(EventItem,2,2000637,1,1)> que je t'ai demandée<nbsp>?
entries.ja: <sheet(EventItem,2000637,0)>は、持ってこれたんだろうな？
entries.de: Hast du mir <denoun(EventItem,1,2000637,1,4,1)> mitgebracht? Dann lass mal sehen!
entries.speaker: WHEISKAET
entries.section: Main Scenario (A Realm Reborn through Endwalker)
entries.category: Seventh Umbral Era Main Scenario Quests

entries.en: Lest you think me overly cautious for testing you in this way, you should know that we had an incident not long ago. A foolish young employee was dismissed for lying about his past. He claimed to have served in the Company of Heroes, but I knew for a fact he did not.
entries.fr: Tu te débrouilles pas mal, la bleusaille.
entries.ja:
……なるほどな。
お前の「力」が偽物でないことはよくわかった。
entries.de: Sehr gut. Du scheinst dich auszukennen mit der Monsterjagd.
entries.speaker: WHEISKAET
entries.section: Main Scenario (A Realm Reborn through Endwalker)
entries.category: Seventh Umbral Era Main Scenario Quests

entries.en: Anyway, now that the pointless busywork is finished, I shall give you a challenge as befits your talents.
entries.fr: Maintenant, on va corser un peu l'affaire.
entries.ja:
では、ゲゲルジュの旦那からの依頼を伝えよう。
今みたいな簡単な仕事とは、わけが違うぞ。
……チビって逃げるなよ？
entries.de: Dann wollen wir mal zur eigentlichen Aufgabe schreiten. Die ist natürlich nicht so einfach.
entries.speaker: WHEISKAET
entries.section: Main Scenario (A Realm Reborn through Endwalker)
entries.category: Seventh Umbral Era Main Scenario Quests

entries.en: Ripples in the water catch your eye...
entries.section: Main Scenario (A Realm Reborn through Endwalker)
entries.category: Seventh Umbral Era Main Scenario Quests
